checks.note: Static code and asset review, ballast authoring render review, and TypeScript/Vite build only. No automated tests, simulation harness, browser gameplay or performance runs executed.

browserChecks.scope: No game browser/playback checks run. HTTP delivery verification only.

bridge.style: matte bowstring side trusses and masonry abutments

map.terrain: plain matte vertex colors; no grass texture/noise

railway.ballast: sloped matte shoulders; absent on bridge

atmosphereFixes: relative vertex grass tint with separate bank/bed paint
diorama.rendering: ACES Filmic exposure 1, six lighting presets; Auto shadows, High GTAO/MSAA; weather softens directional light without changing exposure

traffic.departure: manual at both stations; optional auto dwell
traffic.interlocking: physical section locks; retain occupied blocks until tail clears; acquire braking lead ahead

autoRoster.legacyCollection: preserve IDs/names and ordered first four cars in memory; no storage writes on read

capacity.limitation: Four-car geometric limits retained; staged overtaking and physical storage/collect implemented but end-to-end playback unverified.

normalDirection.loopExit: return to normal lane via downstream crossover

traffic.mixMeaning: intent per 20 scenario deck; storage unavailable falls back to stop; pairs spawn two trains; counters count dispatched scenarios

trackPlan.access: Right-hand operation: J2 -> J4 from east; J3 -> J1 from west; opposite-end crossover restores normal running lane

vegetation.active: original diorama trees, shrubs, grass and flowers
vegetation.placement: deterministic; excludes river, track, station and house footprints

camera.followHandoff: after last car envelope clears visible map
camera.freePan: locked at minimum zoom; opens progressively; full map target range at zoom 2.16
camera.followPan: viewport inset retained while the entire formation clears

hotfix.cause: example maps inherited Riverside railLayout and failed eager registry validation
hotfix.resolution: clear railLayout on non-Riverside example maps

startupRegistryDiagnostic.before: Mountain railway must fit map and approach bounds.

assetLoadingFix.errorDetails: HTTP status and requested asset URL, or network failure
assetLoadingFix.diagnosis: Exact v1 asset URL returned HTTP 200 and a fresh browser session loaded the game. The user-specific cache/transient response failure was not reproduced.
assetLoadingFix.browserDiagnostic: fresh session reached main Riverside HUD with 0 trains and no console errors

colorCalibration.browserScope: 30 time/weather appearance captures and repeated train dispatch; no automated suite

trainVisibilityFix.diagnosis: Template bank was not excluded from batching; scene-wide instancing of merged visual LOD also suppressed bodies. Keep already-merged LOD surfaces native.
trainVisibilityFix.evidence: Two simultaneously active passenger consists show intact locomotive bodies and coach roofs; screenshot train-body-fixed.png

signalling.authority: shared signal-zone reservations to next head or planned stop; scoped points, braking and lamps
signalling.tailProtection: retain occupied blocks and committed route sections until tail clears

artificialLighting.houseWindows: glass palette triangles retain geometry and use a separate emissive material group
artificialLighting.locomotiveMarkers: clock-controlled; moving only; off while stationary and paused
artificialLighting.locomotiveProjection: clock-controlled; moving only; off while stationary and paused
artificialLighting.roadVehicles: clock-controlled headlights; lights off when stopped/loading/unloading or paused; brake lights during moving deceleration

headwayFix.previous: entry head checked only section 3 units beyond pole
headwayFix.now: require destination route through next head or planned stop before entry; keep future route authority after passing pole
headwayFix.simulationChecks: not run; user chose build and deploy

roadTraffic.stationParking: same visible vehicle through arrival, parking, turnaround and departure
roadTraffic.farmFleet: permanent two-vehicle fleet with parking bays and a return-to-bay stage
roadTraffic.crossing: body-length stop limits; admitted vehicles clear before arms lower; trains wait for closure
roadTraffic.collision: shared world footprints across routes and fleet

natureLife.motion: Sparse staggered flocks with flap/glide bursts; small flower-bed loops; session clock owns motion
natureLife.environment: Daytime only; heavy rain, storms and snow suppress activity
natureLife.assetReview: Original Blender kit visually reviewed through a presentation render and eight-frame wing-motion contact sheet; game appearance and performance unmeasured

quietAmbience.riverRipples: Owned by riverWater; old duplicate ripple batch removed
quietAmbience.wind: Root-pinned grass shear using existing instances
quietAmbience.smokeSchedule: Breakfast 05:45-09:15; lunch 11:00-13:45; dinner 16:30-20:00, with gradual fades
quietAmbience.pauseAndReset: Absolute session clock; camera only reorients smoke
quietAmbience.weather: Wind affects motion; rain, storms and darkness reduce smoke

carriageKit.passengerDifference: Executive silver with continuous dark glazing and low AC roof; economy white/orange with separate small windows and high vented roof
carriageKit.ballastLoad: 175 irregular angular crushed rocks in a two-bin discharge hopper
carriageKit.legacyIds: passenger selects economy; freight selects harvest; saved collection IDs and names preserved
carriageKit.farmLoading: Only harvest carriages contribute farm loading capacity
carriageKit.assetReview: Revised ballast authoring render visually reviewed; other five carriage geometry payloads retained. Gameplay articulation and performance unmeasured.

crossingQueue.change: Shared one-vehicle reservation for decorative traffic and farm hauls, including north station/yard turns
crossingQueue.admission: Check continuous vehicle footprint path through exit; other approaches wait outside conflict corridor
crossingQueue.clearance: Retain reservation until vehicle rear clears; retain existing rail gate and collision checks
crossingQueue.validation: Static review and build only; exact screenshot scenario not replayed in simulation

locomotiveFinish.implementation: Owned material clones polished through existing template factories

railOperationsEngine.planning: Adaptive feasible scenario selection from current saved/built-in formations
railOperationsEngine.admission: Atomic batch preparation, approach FIFO, priority and aging across independent approaches
railOperationsEngine.authority: Shared block, turnout and crossing movement decisions used by signals and motion
railOperationsEngine.recovery: Wait-cycle diagnostics and deferred arrivals; scenario holds expire after 90 session seconds without clearing physical locks

riverWater.surface: Shared diorama palette channel-to-bank vertex color gradient
riverWater.clock: Session clock; pause and reset shared with world ambience
riverWater.weather: Wind widens streaks; night, cloud and rain reduce contrast
